summary: Revalidated Labcorp after its 2026-07-30 upper-Bollinger, overbought-RSI, and volume-anomaly signals. The exact alert period ended at USD 315.53, up 11.15%, and the results-day move is explained by the SEC-filed Q2 release: revenue grew 5.8%, adjusted EPS grew 14.9%, both segment margins expanded, and full-year revenue and adjusted-EPS guidance increased. The signal cleared on July 31, while half-year free cash flow declined and acquisition spending, low cash, and leverage remain risks. At the current USD 309.20 mark, the scenario-complete USD 253.40/311.53/371.00 bear/base/bull valuation produces only 0.86% probability-weighted return and 0.65% confidence-adjusted return. The deterministic assessment is complete but ineligible, with Hold/Watch disposition; no conviction strategy or idea follow-up was created because the economic gate failed and no payload or accepted canonical relationship names an idea.
